integrity: The sharp integer three-/four-run plateau is proved analytically, with finite diagnostics. The general odd-run asymptotic from the original package is covered by prior published work and is not a new contribution.
scientific_limitations: Corrected final theorem only counts distinct nonempty binary palindromic subsequence strings for exactly three or four positive runs, for every n>=r. Finite maximizer classification and exact higher-run formulas are not claimed. Priority remains best-of-knowledge.
title: Sharp three–four-run plateau for distinct scattered binary palindromes
